T: A thousand dollars buys a girlfriend. Not dinner.
D: A nerdy teenager pays the most popular girl at school to pretend to date him for a month.
P: Serve the snacks when Ronald and Cindy sit down to lunch as part of the deal.
S: Cool table chicken tenders, honey mustard
panko and parmesan tenderloins baked crisp, crunchy potato gems on the side of the tray

Chicken tenderloins crumbed in panko and parmesan, baked crisp, served on a tray with honey mustard dipping sauce and crunchy potato gems. Toss 600g chicken tenderloins in 50g flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs, then press into 100g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan and paprika. Lay on a lined tray with 500g frozen potato gems, spray with oil and bake at 220C for 20 minutes, turning once, until golden. Mix 3 tbsp Dijon, 3 tbsp honey and 3 tbsp mayonnaise for the dip. Serve on a tray.
Bacon-wrapped cocktail franks in mini rolls with pinto beans, tomato and jalapeño salsa
Mini franks wrapped in bacon and griddled until crisp, tucked into soft rolls with warm pinto beans, diced tomato, onion, mustard and a spoon of jalapeño salsa.
Baked potato skins filled with bacon and cheddar, topped with sour cream
Baked potato halves scooped out, filled with bacon and cheddar, baked crisp and topped with sour cream and chives.
M: chuck braised with chillies, garlic and cumin, rolled with cheddar in tortillas and fried crisp

Beef chuck braised with dried chillies, garlic and cumin until it shreds, rolled with cheddar in flour tortillas, fried crisp, with sour cream and guacamole. Soak 3 dried chillies, blitz with 3 garlic cloves, 1 tsp cumin and 400ml beef stock. Braise 1kg beef chuck in the sauce, covered, at 160C for 3 hours, then shred and reduce until thick. Lay the beef and 150g grated cheddar on 8 large flour tortillas, fold in the sides and roll tightly. Fry seam side down at 180C for 2 minutes a side until crisp. Serve with sour cream and guacamole.
Shredded chicken and cheddar rolled in corn tortillas under red enchilada sauce
Corn tortillas rolled around chicken and cheddar, baked in red chilli sauce under more melted cheese.
W: Vanilla ice cream, dark hot fudge, whipped cream, peanuts and a cherry

Vanilla ice cream in tall glasses with hot fudge of dark chocolate melted into cream, whipped cream piped high, chopped peanuts and a cherry on top. Melt 100g dark chocolate into 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and pipe whipped cream high. Top with chopped peanuts and a cherry.
K: Cranberry lemonade and orange punch, no alcohol. Mind the suede
Cranberry juice and lemonade with sliced orange over ice in a big jug, red enough to make anyone nervous.

dishes.make_ahead: Dice the tomato and onion up to 1 day ahead; wrap the franks in bacon up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled, and griddle to order

steps.text: Dice the tomato and onion and warm the pinto beans.
Wrap the franks in bacon.
Griddle until crisp.
Tuck into the rolls with beans, tomato, onion, mustard and salsa.

veg.make_ahead: Dice the tomato and onion up to 1 day ahead; wrap the sausages in eggplant up to 4 hours ahead, keep chilled, and griddle to order

steps.text: Dice the tomato and onion and warm the pinto beans.
Slice the eggplant lengthways into 16 very thin strips and brush with the oil and smoked paprika.
Wrap each sausage in a strip of eggplant and pin with a toothpick.
Griddle until the eggplant is crisp and browned.
Tuck into the rolls with beans, tomato, onion, mustard and salsa.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; fill and bake again on the night

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with melted butter.
Fry the bacon and fill the skins with bacon and cheddar.
Bake again until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream and chives.

veg.make_ahead: Bake and scoop the potatoes up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; fry the mushrooms, fill and bake again on the night

steps.text: Bake the potatoes at 200C.
Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with melted butter.
Fry the mushrooms in the oil with the smoked paprika until dark and crisp, then fill the skins with mushrooms and cheddar.
Bake again until the cheese melts.
Top with sour cream and chives.

dishes.make_ahead: Fill and roll the tortillas up to 1 day ahead and keep them chilled; add the sauce and cheddar and bake on the night

steps.text: Simmer the chicken in some of the sauce.
Fill the warmed tortillas with the chicken and cheddar, roll and lay in a baking dish.
Pour over the remaining sauce and top with cheddar.
Bake at 190C.
Scatter with coriander.

veg.make_ahead: Roast the sweet potato up to 1 day ahead and keep it chilled; fill, sauce and bake on the night

steps.text: Toss the sweet potato in the oil and roast at 200C until tender.
Simmer the sweet potato and black beans in some of the sauce.
Fill the warmed tortillas with the sweet potato mix and cheddar, roll and lay in a baking dish.
Pour over the remaining sauce and top with cheddar.
Bake at 190C.
Scatter with coriander.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the hot fudge up to 2 days ahead and keep it chilled; whip the cream and scoop to serve

steps.text: Melt the chocolate into some of the cream for hot fudge.
Whip the remaining cream.
Scoop ice cream into four tall glasses and pour over the fudge.
Pipe whipped cream high and top with chopped peanuts and a cherry.

dishes.make_ahead: Slice the orange and chill the cranberry juice up to 1 day ahead; add the lemonade and ice just before serving

steps.text: Pour the cranberry juice and lemonade into a big jug with ice and sliced orange.
Stir gently and pour carefully into glasses.

s.note: Bacon-wrapped cocktail franks in mini rolls with pinto beans, tomato and jalapeño salsa
s.how: Wrap 16 cocktail franks in half rashers of bacon, 8 rashers in total, and griddle until crisp. Tuck into 16 mini rolls with warm pinto beans, diced tomato and onion, mustard and jalapeño salsa.

s.note: Baked potato skins filled with bacon and cheddar, topped with sour cream
s.how: Bake 6 medium potatoes at 200C for 50 minutes. Halve, scoop out most of the flesh and brush the skins with 30g melted butter. Fill with 150g fried diced bacon and 150g grated cheddar, bake 10 minutes more, then top with sour cream and chives.

m.note: Shredded chicken and cheddar rolled in corn tortillas under red enchilada sauce
m.how: Simmer 400g shredded cooked chicken in 500ml red enchilada sauce for 5 minutes. Fill 8 warmed corn tortillas with the chicken and 150g grated cheddar, roll and lay in a baking dish. Pour over 250ml more sauce, top with 100g cheddar and bake at 190C for 20 minutes. Scatter with coriander.

w.note: Vanilla ice cream, dark hot fudge, whipped cream, peanuts and a cherry
w.how: Melt 100g dark chocolate into 100ml cream for hot fudge. Scoop vanilla ice cream into four tall glasses, pour over the fudge and pipe whipped cream high. Top with chopped peanuts and a cherry.

d.note: Cranberry lemonade and orange punch, no alcohol. Mind the suede
d.how: Pour 500ml cranberry juice and 750ml lemonade into a big jug with ice and sliced orange. Stir gently and pour carefully into glasses, nowhere near anyone's borrowed white suede outfit.
